_help: RingGo locations inside Lambeth, copied by hand from the RingGo parking locator (https://myringgo.co.uk/parkinglocator: name search plus each site's tariff summary). All are off-street car parks; Lambeth's own street bays use PayByPhone. Every site below was checked to be inside the London Borough of Lambeth boundary (OpenStreetMap). Add a site: code, name, operator, lat, lng, max_stay, price, note, info_url, checked. Delete a site to drop it.

sites.name: Cornwall Road car park
sites.note: Underground car park. APCOA terms apply.

sites.name: National Theatre car park
sites.price: Mon-Sat £7.50 up to 2 h, £12 4 h, £18 8 h, £28 24 h; £10 after 17:00, Sundays and bank holidays

sites.name: Pearman Street car park
sites.note: Park in bays 1-5 only. Enter the right number plate.

sites.name: Kennington Lane car park
sites.note: Park in the 6 marked bays only.

sites.name: Fentiman Road car park
sites.note: Open the gates yourself. Gates lock at 19:00: collect your car before then.

sites.name: Ferndale Road car park
sites.note: Enforced on site. Enter the right number plate.

sites.name: Sainsbury's Streatham Common car park
sites.note: Park well away from the store entrance. Check opening times with the store.
